{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### Proxmox Mail Gateway Detection Suite｜Proxmox Mail Gateway 偵測套組

`jt-pmg` · rules 132400-132499｜規則 132400-132499

Proxmox Mail Gateway 的登入（含第二因素失敗、密碼噴灑與暴力破解）、病毒與 ClamAV 啟發式命中、已投遞的釣魚信與 DMARC 驗證失敗郵件、新的密件副本目標、外寄病毒／垃圾信／大量外寄、隔離區放行、過濾／叢集／更新／備份故障、漏洞利用嘗試，以及 REST API 變更；Wazuh 內建完全不解碼 PMG。

Logins (including second-factor failures, spraying and brute force), viruses and ClamAV heuristics, phishing and DMARC-failing mail that was delivered, new BCC copy targets, outgoing virus, spam and volume, quarantine releases, filter, cluster, update and backup failures, exploit attempts and REST API changes on Proxmox Mail Gateway, which Wazuh does not decode at all.

Discover query｜在 Discover 使用的查詢:
